scripts.text:
[Yakima]
{0}
I can make some items for you.
They are quite rare nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
{0}
我可以为你制作一些物品。
它们现在相当稀有...

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Oh.. it's an excellent item for any beast hunter.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
噢...这对任何猎人来说都是个不错的物品。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
For the hat I'll need:
1 Sombrero,
920 Feathers of Birds and
310 Bills of Birds.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
制作这个帽子我需要：
1 墨西哥帽，
920 鸟羽，
310 鸟喙。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你都有这些物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Bingo! Many people are afraid of lions... to the muteness...
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
太棒了！很多人看到狮子都会吓得说不出话来...

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
For the hat I'll need:
1 Tiger Mask,
10 Tiger's Footskins,
30 Tiger Skins and
300 Tiger Panties.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
制作这个帽子我需要：
1 老虎面具，
10 虎掌，
30 虎皮，
300 虎纹内裤。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你都有这些物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
I wish I sold this filthy manteau faster...
Guess it isn't so plain as it looks... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
我真希望这件破旧的斗篷能卖得更快点...
看来它并不像看起来那么普通... 嗯。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
I'm giving it almost for free:
10 Old Manteaus,
3 Skull Rings,
2 Manteau[1] and
1 Ragamuffin Manteau.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
我几乎是在白送：
10 旧斗篷，
3 骷髅戒指，
2 斗篷[1]，
1 抗魔斗篷。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你都有这些物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
It's a fresh style! Accessory and a bag all in one! You'd get +2 STR... It's different from that sabby nest!
It fits to Merchant class only.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
这是最新潮的款式！配饰和袋子合二为一！你能获得+2 力量... 这和那个破旧的鸟窝不一样！
只有商人职业可以使用。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Now my stock is full of those bags... So I'll make it from 3 flower things and a rough piece of clothes:
3 Romantic Flowers,
3 Fancy Flowers,
2 Flower Rings and
3 Pirate Bandanas.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
现在我的库存里全是这种袋子... 所以我要用3种花和一块粗糙的布料来制作：
3 花叶，
3 花朵头饰，
2 花戒指，
3 海盗头巾。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你都有这些物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Well, well, well... this sign fits any class from a certain level!
Your foes'd be dazzled!
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
哇，哇，哇... 这块牌子适合达到一定等级的任何职业！
你的敌人会被它晃瞎的！

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Well... we construct it from some common items:
1 Scarlet Dyestuffs,
1 Orange Dyestuffs,
2 Stop Posts,
3 Clown Noses,
180 Fig Leaves and
20 Solid Peaches.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
嗯... 我们用一些常见的物品来制作它：
1 红色染料，
1 赤色染料，
2 停止标志头饰，
3 小丑鼻子，
180 无花果叶，
20 实心桃子。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你都有这些物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
You are lack of items. Please, get all the items.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你的物品不足。请收集齐所有物品。
